latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the image-mixer skill.
- Allows users to merge two photos into a single cohesive image using the WeShop OpenAPI.
- Requires HTTPS access and a WeShop API key, which must be securely handled.
- Supports uploading images, starting merge runs, and polling for results.
- Custom text instructions for image merging and batch generation options (1–16 outputs) are available.
- Includes detailed security guidance and step-by-step usage documentation.
